ktk.text: Narset is the khan of the Jeskai, an outsider in her youth who retreated into imaginary worlds before the elders appointed her to lead, and she keeps a restless mind behind a serene face.

Slipping away from her required meditation, she reads the Annals and learns of clans working together against the dragons and of Ugin and Bolas, then returns to find orcs holding her guard Shintan and ambushes them.
When an orc claims Taigam hired them in revenge for an assassination attempt she denies knowing of, Narset concludes that Tarkir is sick with war.

Later she offers to take Sarkhan to the tomb of the Spirit Dragon, and at the Nexus she holds Zurgo off so Sarkhan can go on, but Zurgo cuts her down and Sarkhan travels back in time; in the new timeline she ignites as a planeswalker and leads the reformed clan.

dtk.text: In the changed Tarkir, Narset never died but became a planeswalker, and her story starts with a restless eight-year-old who hears Ojutai's lesson across the river and asks to be his student.
She trains for three years from afar, studies at Dragon's Eye Sanctuary, and at fifteen defeats Taigam and is named Master by Ojutai, the youngest he has ever named.

Feeling trapped by the sense that there is nothing more to learn, she finds an ancient forbidden archive whose scrolls speak of khans and dragons before Ojutai, and she blasts past Taigam when he threatens to report her.

Her spark ignites as she learns the truth about Ojutai, but she pulls herself back; when Sarkhan finds her walking through the snow, she is content to stay on Tarkir and study Atarka's ivory histories.

mh3.text: Narset brings the Jeskai djinn ancient wisdom and the promise to challenge the status quo.

tdm.text: Narset is the Jeskai waymaster who remembers that in saving Tarkir she lost her dragon, and she tells how she first leapt onto an unformed dragon, bound herself to Shiko and helped drive the dragonlords into the storm.

When Elspeth arrives and explains that dragonstorms are appearing across the Multiverse, Narset admits the ritual may have destabilized Tarkir's balance, and together they defeat a wild dragon inside the school.
At the Crucible, Sarkhan declares that all the Multiverse will become a realm of dragons, and Narset blasts him when he springs up to stab Elspeth in the back.

She and Elspeth step through the dragonstorm into the Meditation Realm, where they meet Jace, who wants to mold the realm to save Vraska; when Elspeth attacks him Narset protects her, and the realm unmakes itself as Jace shatters and Elspeth tells Narset to run.
